title: italy-private-deployment-commercialization-brief
summary: Working brief for commercializing Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) early access in Italy. Focus on position, messaging, sales enablement, and launch checklist for enterprise and regulated mid-market customers. Not final — capture of stakeholder input and open questions.
background: We opened a private beta for Private deployments in EU regions in Q2. Interest from Italian banks, legal, and telecoms has increased — several inbound requests specifically ask for Italy-resident deployments, KMS/HSM integrations, and Italian language support. This doc scopes the go-to-market approach for an Italy-focused early commercial push (beta -> limited GA). Key constraints: local procurement norms, invoicing in EUR, and procurement cycles that prefer longer pilot/POC windows.
goals: Convert 3 pilot customers to paid contracts within 6 months
Establish 2 channel partnerships with local MSPs/SIs for deployment and compliance support
Create an Italian-language marketing kit and one localized case study (pilot) by GA
Reduce sales cycle friction by publishing a clear TCO and compliance FAQ for Italy
target_personas: Platform/Infra engineering lead at mid-market enterprise (telco, fintech, legal)
Head of ML/AI wanting predictable inference costs and low latency for customer-facing apps
Security/compliance lead (DPO, InfoSec) evaluating data residency and KMS/HSM controls
Procurement manager who needs clear commercial terms and EUR invoicing
key_value_props_primary: Data residency & private control plane: deploy inside Italy (customer VPC or on-prem) with customer-managed network
Predictable performance and cost: dedicated capacity option with SLA-backed latency and throughput
Enterprise-grade security: KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, SOC2/ISO readiness (detail certs in sales pack)
Developer-first API consistent with hosted Redwood — easy migration between hosted and private
support_proofs: We ran a 3-week pilot with a Milan-based fintech: 30% lower p50 latency compared to cloud-region fallback using edge routing
KMS integration with AWS KMS + customer HSM tested in staging (demo recording available)
Model catalog curated for inference cost: recommended quantized variants for customer workloads (savings projection included)
Reference architecture diagrams and runbook ready for partner deployments
competitive_landscape_notes: Short notes: Major cloud hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) can offer local infra but lack Redwood's inference-optimized runtime and unified API. Local MSPs/consultancies (Aruba Cloud integrators, regional systems integrators) provide customization and procurement familiarity — good partners but not turnkey inference platform. LLM API vendors (US incumbents) compete on simplicity but typically don’t offer on-prem/private control plane at scale or predictable reserved capacity SLAs. Sales play: emphasize predictable unit economics + faster time-to-value versus building a custom stack internally.
launch_tone_and_headlines: English headline: "Redwood Private — Italian-region early access for secure, high-performance LLM inference"
Italian headline (short): "Redwood Private: Early access in Italia per inference LLM sicuro e performante"
Tone: pragmatic, engineering-first, compliance-aware — avoid hype; speak to cost predictability and operational maturity
Primary CTA: Request a pilot — talk to our Italy team
channel_plan: 1) Field webinars (Milan, hybrid) targeting infra and ML engineers; 2) Co-marketing with two MSP/SI partners for case study readiness; 3) PR outreach to Italian tech press and legal/regulation outlets with an emphasis on data residency and compliance; 4) Developer outreach: localized quickstart repo + sample stacks (Terraform/VPN) on GitHub; 5) Sales outreach: targeted account research and executive briefings for pilot candidates.
sales_enablement_bullets: One-pager: Italian procurement checklist (EUR billing, PO terms, data residency confirmations)
Pre-packaged pilot agreement template (30-90 days) and scope of work for partner deployments
Technical demo playbook: latency benchmarks, KMS demo steps, troubleshooting checklist
Pricing guidance: reserved capacity vs burst model examples in EUR with sample TCO for 100k tokens/day
objection_handling_snippets: "We can just use a hosted API" — hosted API is great for speed to value; Private gives you control over network boundaries, KMS/HSM integration, and predictable reserved throughput for production SLAs

"Will this meet AGID / public-sector needs?" — early conversations show Private satisfies core network and residency requirements; we will document controls and engagement model for public sector procurement
"Is it more expensive than building ourselves?" — include a simple TCO: engineering ops + infra build vs Redwood managed private with predictable unit economics and faster time to production
launch_checklist: Finalize Italian-language sales kit and one-pager (PMM)
Legal: final review of pilot agreement and EUR invoicing terms
Security: publish Italy-specific compliance FAQ and certificate list
Ops: validate partner deployment runbook with 2 SI partners
Marketing: schedule Milan webinar and press outreach
Customer success: assign named CSM for each pilot
open_questions: What level of localization (UI, docs) is required for GA vs beta?
Which local partners have legal/compliance benches that match our customers' expectations?
Do we need an Italy-resident control plane or is VPC-in-region sufficient for target customers?
Pricing: should we offer an introductory EUR discount for first-year pilots?
